issue_context.title: Cop to limit the number of safe navigation calls in a chain
issue_context.body:
It is painful to see many `&.` calls in a chain.

If I want to have at most 2 safe navigation calls in a row, for example, then:
```ruby
# bad
foo&.bar&.baz&.zoo

# good
foo&.bar&.baz
```
comments:
It seems like this should be discussed in the style guide first. Please start a discussion there first.
https://github.com/rubocop/ruby-style-guide

review_comments: Can you add some test cases such as `1` or `3`, in addition to case `2`?

You might want to add a bit of rationale here as well, as one of the most common feedback we receive from users is that they don't understand from the cop docs alone what's the reasoning behind some of our rules.
